content_zh:
“医生, 快帮我看看, 我忽然肚子好疼！”
他话音刚落, 一阵脚步声传来, 男人抬头看去，却见一个留着黑色长卷发的年轻女生走了出来，他愣道：“姑娘, 你父亲呢？我现在肚子疼，让他出来给我看看！”
苏檀知道他是误会了，她洗好手, 淡声说：“我就是你找的医生。”
“你？”明显的质疑。
苏檀没做声, 前世她早已习惯这样的质疑，世人总认为中医就跟古董一样, 越老越好, 见她是个年轻女生, 下意识认为她的医术不好, 她见多了这类场面, 习惯用实力让这帮人闭嘴。
“哪里不舒服？”
男人一脸狐疑, 说：“忽然肚子疼。”
“伸出胳膊，手心朝上。”
男人看了伙伴一眼，不情不愿地伸出手, 苏檀手指轻轻搭在他的脉上, 片刻后，她表情淡淡地扫了男人一眼。
对上她的视线，矮个男人眼神瑟缩，下意识移开视线，不知为何，这位女医生的眼神太过犀利，像是能洞察一切，让他那点并不光明正大的小心思顿时无所遁形。
“怎么样？医生，我朋友是怎么了？”一旁高个男人问。
苏檀扫了他们一眼，指着大门淡声说：“各位，我家门在那边，从哪来往哪去！”
这话一出，几人不仅没有生气，反而都是脸色一红。
高个男人讪笑：“您的意思是我朋友没病？”
一直装肚子疼的男人心里一惊，当下站起来，连连赔罪：
“对不起医生，我们是来旅游的，走岔路路过这里，见你挂出那个牌子，就想试探一番，不想得罪了您。”
他确实很意外，事实上他心里对中医是十分不屑的，在他印象中，中医没病都能看出有病来，总爱给人拿一堆调理的药，一吃就是一两个月，见效又慢，根本没什么用，哪像西医，吃完药立刻就见效了，是真的能治病的。
这次他们来麦山买茶旅游，见这家医馆奇怪，便想进来看看，进来前就说好了，先由他试一试，如果对方给他开一堆药，说他肠胃不好什么的，他们转头就走，谁知被苏檀一眼戳破，实在尴尬。
“抱歉，医生，我不该没病装病，我……”
“谁说你没病来着？”苏檀扫了他一眼。

男人一愣，随即哂笑，果然，他就说中医就是这样，你就是没病，他们都说你身体亚健康，要么就是脾虚、肾虚、阴阳不调之类的，总之说的十分玄乎，最后都要开一些方药给你吃，不吃个几个月不罢休，看来这女人也这样，他有病？他有什么病？他原以为对方很厉害，看出自己装病，原来是他高看了她，她和其他中医一样，都喜欢没病说有病。
男人挑起唇角，明显嘲讽：
“怎么？该不会说我肠胃有问题，想给我开一些调理的药吧？”
苏檀哪里不知道他的想法？自打他进门的那刻起，她就察觉出，这人不是真的来看病的。
见他明显不信中医，苏檀懒得多说，只问：“你是不是经常右肋疼痛？”
男人呆愣片刻，吞吞吐吐很久没说出话。
“还有，你经常夜里冒冷汗，常有呕吐，舌苔发黑，不能吃酸？”
男人吓得当下站起来，当即惊道：“你怎么知道？”
他确实有这些症状，这两年他因为肋骨疼去过不少医院，有医生说他是胆上有结石要开刀，后来他找家里的亲戚看了，人家说他胆上没什么问题，根本不需要做手术，只这几年，经常有上述症状，一直查不出原因来。
“贾勇，她说中了？你真是这样？”高个男人问。
“是！我以前经常呕吐，你们不是还开玩笑说我怀孕了吗？”
高个男人这才想到有这茬，一群人都被吓到似的，不敢相信地盯着苏檀。
苏檀倒是淡定，面无表情地抽出纸，刷刷刷开始写字，贾勇凑过去，疑惑道：
“医生，我这是什么病？是不是要开刀做手术？”
“开什么刀！动不动就开刀，谁带来的坏习惯！”
贾勇被她一怼，也没敢说话，静静地等她开完药方，而后拿起苏檀写好的纸，读道：
“细辛、川椒、木香……姜汁、蜂蜜！这怎么还有蜂蜜？医生，我到底是什么病？”
苏檀见他紧张，温声说：“没大问题，只是胆道有蛔虫。”
“蛔虫……”

content_en:
"Doctor, please help me, I suddenly have a bad stomachache!"
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a sound of footsteps. The man looked up and saw a young girl with long black curly hair walking out. He was stunned and said: "Girl, where is your father? I have a stomachache now. Let him come out and take a look!"
Su Tan knew that he had misunderstood. She washed her hands and said softly, "I am the doctor you are looking for."
"You?" Obviously questioning.
Su Tan remained silent. In her previous life, she had long been accustomed to such questions. People in the world always believed that Chinese medicine was like antiques, and the older the better. Seeing that she was a young girl, she subconsciously thought that her medical skills were not good. She had seen many such scenes and was used to using her strength to shut up these people.
"Where do you feel uncomfortable?"
The man looked suspicious and said, "Suddenly, my stomach hurts."
"Extend your arms, palms up."
The man glanced at his partner and reluctantly stretched out his hand. Su Tan gently placed her fingers on his pulse. After a moment, she glanced at the man with an indifferent expression.
When he met her gaze, the short man winced and subconsciously looked away. For some reason, the female doctor's eyes were too sharp, as if he could see through everything, and his little thoughts that were not above board were immediately revealed.
"How is it? Doctor, what's wrong with my friend?" asked the tall man on the side.
Su Tan glanced at them, pointed to the door and said quietly: "Everyone, my door is over there, where can I go from here?"
As soon as these words came out, not only were they not angry, but their faces turned red.
The tall man sneered: "You mean my friend is not sick?"
The man who had been pretending to have a stomachache was shocked. He stood up and apologized again and again:
"I'm sorry, doctor, we are here for a trip. We took a side road and passed by here. When I saw you hanging that sign, I wanted to test it. I didn't want to offend you."
He was indeed surprised. In fact, he was very disdainful of Chinese medicine. In his impression, Chinese medicine could tell whether there was a disease or not. They always gave people a bunch of conditioning medicines, which they took for a month or two. The effects were slow and useless. It was not like Western medicine. The medicines were effective immediately after taking them, so they could really cure diseases.
This time they came to Maishan to buy tea and saw the strange medical clinic, so they wanted to come in and have a look. They agreed before coming in that he would give it a try first. If the other party prescribed a bunch of medicine for him and said he had a bad stomach or something, they turned around and left. Unexpectedly, Su Tan exposed it at a glance, which was really embarrassing.
"Sorry, doctor, I shouldn't have pretended to be sick, I..."
"Who said you're not sick?" Su Tan glanced at him.
The man was stunned, then laughed, and sure enough, he said that this is what Chinese medicine is like, you are not sick, they all said that your body is sub-healthy, or you have spleen deficiency, kidney deficiency, yin and yang imbalance, etc. In short, it is very mysterious. In the end, they will prescribe some prescriptions for you to take, and you will not give up if you don't take it for several months. It seems that this woman is like this too, is he sick? What's wrong with him? He originally thought that the other party was very powerful, but when he saw that she was pretending to be sick, it turned out that he looked down on her. She, like other Chinese medicine doctors, liked to say that she was sick when she was not sick.
The man raised the corners of his lips, clearly mocking:
"What? Are you saying that I have a gastrointestinal problem and you want to give me some medicine to treat it?"
How could Su Tan not know what he was thinking? From the moment he walked in, she realized that this man was not really here to see a doctor.
Seeing that he obviously didn't believe in Chinese medicine, Su Tan didn't bother to say anything more and just asked: "Do you often have pain in your right rib?"
The man was stunned for a moment, hesitating and saying nothing for a long time.
"Also, you often have cold sweats at night, vomiting, and black tongue coating. Can't you eat sour foods?"
The man was so frightened that he stood up immediately and said in surprise: "How do you know?"
He did have these symptoms. In the past two years, he had been to many hospitals because of rib pain. Some doctors said he had gallbladder stones and needed surgery. Later, he went to see relatives at home and they said he had nothing to do with his gallbladder.The problem is that there is no need for surgery at all. In the past few years, I have often had the above symptoms, and the cause has never been found.
"Jia Yong, is she right? Are you really like this?" the tall man asked.
"Yes! I used to vomit a lot. Didn't you still joke that I was pregnant?"
Only then did the tall man think of this, and a group of people stared at Su Tan in disbelief as if they were frightened.
Su Tan was calm. He pulled out the paper expressionlessly and started writing. Jia Yong leaned over and said doubtfully:
"Doctor, what's wrong with me? Do I need an operation?"
"What kind of surgery! Why do you need surgery at all times? Who brought this bad habit!"
Jia Yong was scolded by her and did not dare to speak. He waited quietly for her to finish writing the prescription, then picked up the paper written by Su Tan and read:
"Asarum, Sichuan pepper, woody... ginger juice, honey! Why is there honey here? Doctor, what on earth is wrong with me?"
Seeing that he was nervous, Su Tan said warmly, "It's not a big problem, it's just that there are roundworms in the bile duct."
"Ascaris..."
